subject.title: [Feature]: Control UI: chat markdown tables lack numeric alignment/stripes; no paragraph gap after lists

question: Should Control UI infer numeric and signed-delta semantics from table cell text, or limit this improvement to neutral styling and explicit Markdown column alignment?
rationale: Spacing and zebra styling are straightforward, but content inference and success/danger coloring establish new presentation semantics that current renderer contracts do not define.

options.title: Neutral readability first
options.body: Add list spacing, header rules, zebra rows, tabular numerals, and preserve explicit Markdown alignment while deferring automatic delta coloring.

options.title: Infer numeric columns
options.body: Also classify numeric-dominant columns in the renderer and right-align them under a narrow, tested parsing contract.

options.title: Include delta semantics
options.body: Add numeric inference plus success/danger coloring for signed-delta columns with accessibility and theme-token review.

recommendation.title: Neutral readability first
recommendation.body: Add list spacing, header rules, zebra rows, tabular numerals, and preserve explicit Markdown alignment while deferring automatic delta coloring.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice concerns the default visual and semantic behavior of the existing Control UI rather than only renderer mechanics.
